title: 'Proxies' Is Coming to Netflix on December 11
summary: A Thriller by Oriol Paulo Starring Eduard Fernández, Mario Casas, Blanca Suárez, Nicolás Francella, and Alexandra Jiménez
body_markdown:
Entertainment


04 November 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


[Discover teaser](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O-BNo1l6yPI)


[Download first images](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/96c23e41-b423-4942-b2ee-b7312c8c2f4f)


Netflix has today unveiled the teaser and first-look images for


Proxies


, a new thriller starring


Eduard Fernández


(


The 47, God's Crooked Lines


),


Mario Casas


(


The Dinner, The Innocent


),


Blanca Suárez


(


Hidden Murder, Breathless


),


Nicolás Francella


(


The House of the Spirits, High Seas


) and


Alexandra Jiménez


(


Go Team!, 53 Sundays


). The film will


premiere globally on Netflix on December 11


.


Directed by


Oriol Paulo


(


The Innocent, God's Crooked Lines, The Invisible Guest


), the film tells the story of how, on Christmas Eve morning, a man walks into a police station and confesses to killing two or three people. Yet, behind his confession lies a question that is harder to answer: why he has decided to turn himself in now, and what he hopes to achieve with his confession. From that point on, his story soon becomes linked to another seemingly closed case, one that defies all logic.


The cast also includes


Blanca Parés


(


Legacy, Julieta


),


Javier Beltrán


(


Dreams of Freedom, The Messiah


),


Marta Bayarri


(


The Map of Longings, My Loneliness Has Wings


) and


Ana Wagener


(


If It's Tuesday, It's Murder, The Innocent


).


Speaking about the film, Oriol Paulo says:


“With Proxies, I wanted to create a thriller that, beyond the suspense, carried the emotional weight of a tragedy. A story in which guilt, pain and the need to find answers ultimately drive the characters towards the erosion of their own moral principles.”


Proxies


is a


Juanita Films


production, written by


Oriol Paulo


and


Guillem Clua


.


Oriol Paulo


and


Miguel Ángel Faura


serve as executive producers and produce alongside


Libertad Ribera


and


Jaume Martí


. Cinematography is by


Bernat Bosch


, with an original score by


Fernando Velázquez


.


About Juanita Films


Founded by screenwriter and director Oriol Paulo alongside Libertad Ribera, Juanita Films is a Barcelona-based production company dedicated to developing and producing film and television projects. The company was established with the aim of bringing original stories to life, with a distinctive narrative identity and strong international appeal. Its first production is


Proxies


, a Netflix original thriller.
